title: DualMap shared-inference refactor: 17/17 scenarios pass
summary: The tested merge commit d3ab7aab (PR #333 head merged into dev) passed the Webots scenario suite 17/17 with no failures. The change set reworks the Scene perception stack so ConceptGraphs and DualMap share one inference implementation, adds a pinned DualMap source preparation step with an injected inference patch, and extends TensorRT export/engine building to FastSAM and a separate Replica text encoder. All exercised capabilities (camera/lidar snapshots, navigation, memory, explore, scene queries, executor builtins) behaved as expected.
pr_changes: CI workflow installs opencv-python-headless and adds new Scene unit tests (perception models, prepare_dualmap, prepare_models, build_engines, prepare_viewer, inference_config) plus two new perception_engines tests.

Scene README documents DualMap Lite model selection, FP32 engine builds with TF32 disabled, Jetson DualMap support, the dualmap-inference.patch, point-cloud subsampling, CLIP preprocessing reuse, and the 672-square vs 640-rectangular TensorRT/Torch input difference.

Dockerfile.dualmap now copies a prepared _build/dualmap source tree and dualmap-inference.patch instead of cloning DualMap, installs requirements/scene-perception-dualmap.txt, and sets SCENE_DUALMAP_ROOT and SCENE_DUALMAP_EXPORT_CLIP.
Dockerfile.jetson adds optional DualMap requirements install, SCENE_PERCEPTION_BACKEND/SCENE_DUALMAP_ROOT env, copies _build/dualmap, and derives TensorRT export model names from inference_config.

New docker/dualmap-LICENSE (Apache-2.0) and a large docker/dualmap-inference.patch that injects an inference object into DualMap's Detector, replaces Torch mask-overlap filtering with NumPy, and makes FastSAM/YOLO/SAM/CLIP calls go through the shared implementation.
New docker/requirements/scene-perception-dualmap.txt (supervision, open_clip_torch, faiss-cpu, networkx, scikit-learn, distinctipy, plyfile, pympler, dill, tabulate).

inference_config.py adds model_profile(), backend-aware model_defaults/model_config (DualMap uses MobileSAM + MobileCLIP-S2 + FastSAM + replica CLIP), export_model_names(), and relaxes validate_tensorrt_config to accept dualmap.
cg_export.py adds _serialize_objects to accept either to_serializable() or plain lists.
perception_concept_graphs.py delegates model loading to the new perception_models.load_perception.

perception_dualmap.py adds TensorRT engine loading with prepare_dualmap.verify, model_config-driven weights, injected inference, Torch-free Replica text encoder via ONNX, and error propagation on export failure.

perception_engines.py bumps ENGINE_BUILD_VERSION to 3, generalizes letterbox/unletterbox, adds instance_masks() for FastSAM segmentation, clip interpolation option, trt_model_names(), and optional FastSAM engine loading.
New perception_models.py with load_perception() and create_clip_model() (local-weight transform reuse, capability-based reparameterization).
perception_torch.py adds device override, FastSAM support, segment_instances(), and a lock-guarded cuDNN TF32 disable/restore around CLIP image encoding.

build.sh installs viewer assets and DualMap requirements for native builds, handles DualMap weight selection, builds the DualMap image layer before TensorRT compilation, and switches NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES to compute,utility.
build_engines.py adds per-row embedding gates, score gates, optional replica-text and fastsam specs, TF32 disabled, and dynamic FastSAM shape profiles.

check_docker.py, export_models.py (FastSAM and Replica text export, fused-attention expansion, black/white reference inputs), prepare_docker.py, new prepare_dualmap.py, prepare_models.py, prepare_native.py, new prepare_viewer.sh, start.sh, start_native.sh updated accordingly.
Many new/updated Scene tests covering DualMap filtering, instance masks, export parity, prepare_dualmap safety, viewer assets, and inference config.
test_result: The Webots scenario suite ran 17 scenarios across flow, builtin, and cap families and reported 17 passed, 0 failed (rate 1.0). Coverage included camera and lidar snapshots, map save, memory save/search/remember/hybrid_search/promote, navigation navigate, speech speak, voiceprint list, explore start/status/cancel, chronos wall time, executor read/write/list/run_command, and scene list_objects/goal_near. object_navigation completed explore (expected 8s ceiling), listed a scene object, resolved a reachable approach pose for potted_plant, and navigation returned SUCCEEDED. The lifecycle/rerun summary also passed with expected outage errors only.

evidence.text: Prepare the pinned DualMap source with an injectable inference implementation.

suggested_fix: No fix required for this run. Follow up by watching the new DualMap/TensorRT paths: the 672-square TensorRT vs 640-rectangular Torch preprocessing difference can change detections, and the DualMap image layer plus FastSAM/Replica engine builds add build-time cost and new failure surfaces that this ConceptGraphs-backed scenario run does not exercise.
risks_or_watchouts: Scenarios ran with SCENE_PERCEPTION_BACKEND=concept_graphs and SCENE_CG_INFERENCE=torch, so the new DualMap and TensorRT code paths were not exercised by this suite.
boot log warns several cached provider checkouts have uncommitted changes, so the run is not fully reproducible from branches alone.
Scene logs show repeated 'missing: gone from the tracker' churn and 'stand on unmapped ground; not registered' messages, indicating object retention instability worth monitoring.
TensorRT uses 672 square inputs while Torch keeps 640 rectangular, so backend switches can change detections; numerical comparisons must use matching preprocessing.
DualMap image layer and FastSAM/Replica engine builds add build time and new failure modes not covered by this scenario run.
